name: Bab Al-Hara
description: A modern classic of Arab television. A social drama set in the 1920s in Damascus- It highlights Damascene life, noble values, and ancient customs and traditions represented by the people of Harat al-Dabeh who fled to Harat al-Salihiyah after the French bombed Harat al-Dabeh. The events take place after the gold is stolen from the house of the cloth merchant Abu Ibrahim, and the guard Abu al-Samu is killed. The men of the neighborhood try to find the thief.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Al-Ad'ashari stole Abu Ibrahim's gold and killed the guard Abu Samu, and the people of the neighborhood tried to search for the perpetrator.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Al-Adashari's wife was shocked after her husband buried Abu Samu's body in their home cemetery. Bouran suffered because of her husband's bad treatment of her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Abu Ibrahim suspected that Al-Adashari was the gold thief after seeing his shoes in his house, and the leader Abu Saleh decided to make sure and searched his house, but he found nothing.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Abu Jawdat tortured Al-Adashari after Abu Ibrahim filed a complaint against him that he was a gold thief.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Abu Majid took over the guard of the lane. Al-Adashari refused to confess despite Abu Jawdat's torture.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The leader Abu Saleh asked Abu Ibrahim to waive his right to release al-Adashari. Abu Hassan asked the leader to help them to support the people of Palestine and deliver weapons to them.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Al-Adashari decided to extricate himself and accused Abu Samu. Abu Shehab decided to monitor Al- .Adashari; In the end, Abu Ibrahim waived his right

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Al-Adashari left Al-Hara after knowing that Abu Shehab was watching him; Abu Saleh asked Abu Nar to intervene to return to the lane.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Al-Adashari incited Abu al-Nar against the people of Haret al-Dabaa and they began their plan. Abu al-Nar’s aunt died and the people of Haret al-Daba’ offered their condolences.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Al-Adashari told Abu al-Nar of the harassment of the people of Haret al-Dabaa because after the death of his aunt the house became his. It became clear that Zahra, after she contracted a fever when she was young, had lost her hearing and speech.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Issam learned about Saeed beating his sister Bran and insulting him, Moataz, and Abu Issam reprimanded his children.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Abu Khater decided to marry his daughter, Zahra, to Riyadh, and he would take care of the expenses of the marriage. Abu Shehab gave the men of the Palestinian revolution money to buy weapons. Abu Draa agreed to marry Shafiqa, the daughter of Al-Adashari.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Shafiqa married Abu Draa, Abu Essam decided to marry his son Essam to Lotfia, but Souad decided not to consummate the marriage because of her dispute with Ferial.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Abu Issam knew that Souad had lied to him and resolved to marry Essam and Lotfia and forced Souad to visit them to formally request her.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Feryal apologized to Souad by order of Abu Saleh, and they agreed on a date for the marriage, and both families got back together.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The people of the neighborhood decided to help Abu Ibrahim in his crisis. Abu Khater learned about Riyad’s high morals and his care for his sisters. Al-Adashari’s wife passed away after her struggle with illness.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Issam and Lotfia got married. Abu Shehab decided to put an end to Abu Nar's behavior. Khater ruined Riyad's work because of his extreme jealousy of him.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Abu Khater reprimanded his son for harming Riyad. He decided to volunteer with the police. The leader looked after a young beggar named Satif who was out of his mind.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Abu Khater offered Riyad to marry Zahra and took care of everything and told him about her loss of hearing and speech, in light of Al-Adashari's attempts to treat his children in a harsh manner.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Riyad agreed to marry Zahra and was reassured by Abu Khater, but Khater felt that Riyad was covetous of his father's wealth and decided not to consummate the marriage.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Al-Adashari stood with the people of Haret al-Dabaa against Abu al-Nar to reach his goal, which is his return to his home.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Khater refused to go to work, though, and Riyad and Zahra got married, to the delight of her father.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Abu Shehab suspected Setif, after the police attacked his house, the wedding of Zahra and Riad took place. Abu Al-Nar asked Abu Ghaleb to monitor Al-Adashari.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The government decided to put its control over the lands taken without right, and Al-Adashari decided to expedite the exit of gold from his grandfather's tomb.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Issam prepared for his wedding, but his joy was not complete, as the wedding was canceled due to the death of Saleh, the son of the leader.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The police attacked the revolutionaries and al-Zaybak died. Maarouf died after being bitten by a snake. Abu Shehab confirmed that there was a spy in the neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Al-Adashari felt remorse after the death of his son Maarouf, Riyad could not bear Khater's bad treatment of him and decided to put an end to this problem.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: He heals Abu Issam - Abu Hassan After his injury, Riyad ceded the property to Abu Khater and resided in his family home. On the other hand, Issam married Lutfia.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Khater apologized to Riyad. Al-Adashari arrested Abu Satour after trying to burn Abu Shehab’s shop. Al-Adashari’s arm was amputated after he had gangrene, and the people of the neighborhood stood with him.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Abu Shehab asked the youth of the neighborhood to guard it. The infant son of Abu Hatim died, and the people of the neighborhood tried to play it down.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Abu Draa’ quit working with Abu al-Nar. Abu Shehab learned about Abu al-Nar’s intention to harm him. Al-Adashari tried to tell the leader about his theft of gold because he could not bear it.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Al-Adashari told the members of the neighborhood that he stole Abu Ibrahim's gold and killed him for Abu Samu, and asked them to forgive him, and he died after that.

videos.title: Finale Episode
videos.overview: Sobhi sold the house and left the neighborhood after his father's actions. Abu Samir was killed, and the leader searched behind his killing, and it turned out that Setif was the spy.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Chief Abu Saleh grows suspicious of Satif when the latter disappears from the neighborhood. As Abu Issam divorces Sou'ad, he eventually decides to take her back.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sou'ad admonishes Abu Issam for what he did to her. As Satif kills Chief Abu Saleh, Abu Shehab vows to avenge him and find his killer.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Abu Al-Nar reconciles with Abu Shehab. Umm Ibrahim decides to have her son Ibrahim engaged to Dalal.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Abu Shehab identifies the thief, he decides to hire him to prevent him from stealing again. Dalal and Ibrahim officiate their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Ferial incites Fawzya against Sou'ad. As Issam beats his brother, Mo'taz, over Lotfiya, Abu Issam interferes to resolve the situation.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When Sou'ad insults Abu Issam, he divorces her and leaves the house to stay in his shop.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Ferial learns about Sou'ad's divorce, she decides to spread the story around. Mo'taz tries to convince his parents to get back together to keep the neighborhood from talking about them.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Ferial tells the neighborhood woman about Sou'ad divorce. As Abu Issam continues to stay at his shop, he learns that two men are planning to break into the house of Abu Samir's widow to rob her.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As the news about Abu Issam and Sou'ad's divorce spread, Abu Jassem takes his sister home. On his father's orders, Ibrahim divorces Dalal.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: When Sa'eid taunts Bouran with her mother's divorce, Issam teaches him a lesson. Ibrahim's spirits plummet after his divorce from Dalal.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: As Abu Issam returns to his work, he helps Ibrahim move on from his crisis. Abu Bashir stands with Abu Issam.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Abu Bashir beats Abu Ghaleb when he learns that the latter is the one who spread the news of Abu Issam's divorce. Issam kicks Lotfiya out because of what her mother did.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Ferial resorts to charlatanry to ensure that Lotfiya will return to her husband. Issam separates from Lotfiya over her mother's actions.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As Abu Shehab receives the weapons, he brings them to Abu Hassan. Abu Issam unsuccessfully tries to catch the men who disguised themselves as women.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: When Abu Shehab returns to the neighborhood, he learns of his sister's divorce and admonishes her for insulting her husband. Abu Issam tries to reconcile Lotfiya and Issam, but Ferial refuses.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Abu Shehab posts guards on Abu Samir's house. Mo'taz settles scores with Abu Badr. Abu Shehab refuses to reconcile with Abu Issam.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Issam learns that Lotfiya is pregnant. Abu Issam tells Abu Shehab that Satif is a spy and that he is the one who killed Chief Abu Saleh.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Mo'taz beats Abu Ghaleb. Abu Al-Nar quarrels with the neighborhood people. When Abu Issam learns that Jamila has met with Bashir, he beats her.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Abu Bashir apologizes for his son's actions and asks Abu Issam for Jamila's hand for Bashir. Ferial files a complaint against Issam.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As Abu Shehab receives the weapons, he asks the neighborhood men to help him, but Abu Al-Nar steals two guns. Issam gets released from prison after Abu Shehab intervenes to secure his release.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: As Abu Shehab prevents Ferial from buying merchandise from the neighborhood to punish her, Abu Issam opposes him. Abu Shehab finds out Satif's location and plans to arrest him.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Abu Shehab kills Satif. Abu Issam agrees to wed Bashir to Jamila and Issam to Hoda. The two couples celebrate their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Issam decides to take his wife back. Abu Shehab gets detained by the English forces, along with some of the neighborhood's young men, but Abu Hassan and the neighborhood people intervene.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The neighborhood learns that Abu Issam was martyred. After a while, Abu Shehab asks his sister and her children to try and move on from Abu Issam's death.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mo'taz refuses to wed after his father's death. Ferial sets conditions to approve Lotfiya's marriage to Issam. Abu Shehab and Abu Ibrahim agree on Dalal's marriage.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Abu Ghaleb decides to marry the widow of Abu Samir. Abu Al-Nar asks the neighborhood's people to rent Abu Samir's shop to Abu Ghaleb, but they refuse his request.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Abu Ghaleb decides to take revenge on Abu Hatem. Ibrahim weds Dalal. Abu Hatem refuses to marry one of his daughters to Abdu. It's revealed that Hamdy is a spy who is working for the English forces.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Umm Khater dies in an accident. Issam goes back to Lotfiya. Abu Shehab asks Abu Hatem for his daughter's hand in marriage.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Abu Hassan asks Mo'taz to inform Abu Shehab about the efforts to arm the Palestinians. Sherifa weds Abu Shehab. Zahra gives birth to a boy.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Abu Shehab receives the weapons. Adham gathers his friends to ignite the spark of revolution against the French army.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Hoda and Lotfiya clash. Abu Jawdat blackmails Nouri. The neighborhood's youth delivers weapons to the Palestinians.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Abu Ghaleb sabotages the business of Abu Bashir to take revenge on him. When Abu Arab grows suspicious of Sobhy, he asks Abu Siyah to monitor him.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Lotfiya gives birth to a girl. Ferial and Sou'ad reconcile. Abu Khater decides to wed his daughter, Khairiya, to Kamal. Abu Ghaleb causes sales in Abu Bashir's bakery to drop.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mo'taz is distressed when he learns that Khairiya has gotten married. When Abu Ibrahim falls ill, the doctor asks his son to take him to the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Abu Bashir learns that Abu Ghaleb is behind what happened to him. Abu Ibrahim passes away. When Dr. Hamza treats Umm Hatem, Abu Hatem asks him to move to the neighborhood to treat the sick. A French man kills a child in the neighborhood of Al-Dab'a.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As the French officer fabricates the medical report on the deceased Arab, Abu Arab decides to take revenge on the neighborhood of Al-Dab'a. Abu Nasouh sues Ibrahim for seizing his father's house.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After joining the police ranks, Sam'u decides to avenge his father. Ferial quarrels with Umm Bashir. Hamdy incites Abu Arab against the neighborhood of Al-Dab'a.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Sam'u decides to interrogate the residents of the neighborhood to find his father's killer. Issam asks his mother to sell the house to put an end to the fight between his wives, but his wife rebuffs him.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Ibrahim remains determined to restore his rights. Hamdy tries to kill Abu Shehab to drive a wedge between the neighborhoods of Al-Mawy and Al-Dab'a. As Kamal decides to use the law to take Khairiya, Khater and his father stand in his way.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Abu Al-Nar unites with Abu Arab against the people of the neighborhood. As Abu Hatem's coffee shop burns down, the neighborhood's people join the efforts to clean it up and restore it to its former glory.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Abu Jawdat steals Nouri's gun as he plots to harm him. Abu Shehab admonishes Issam and Mo'taz for not supporting their sister, Bouran, in the wake of her husband's illness. Khairiya gets divorced.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Bouran decides to expand her seamstress business. As Abu Hatem tries to reconcile his neighborhood and the neighborhood of Al-Mawy, Abu Arab rejects the truce. Adham and Abu Shehab join forces against the French army.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As Abu Siyah reconciles with Abu Shehab and the neighborhood's people, he tries to calm Abu Arab down. Sa'eid offers his son up to Abu Siyah, but the latter refuses to kill a young child.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Mo'taz decides to work with Khater. Abu Arab buys the house of Abu Al-Nar to make the neighborhood's people angry.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Mo'taz gets engaged to Khairiya. Abu Hatem decides to wed one of his daughters to a Muslim. Sobhy kills a French officer who tried to sexually harass a woman.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sam'u gets Sobhy released. Abu Siyah kills Hamdy when he discovers that he is the spy. Abu Shehab aids the revolutionaries. When the English officers raid the neighborhood, the neighborhood's people face off against them.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As the English forces besiege Al-Dab'a neighborhood, a number of the neighborhood's young men get martyred, including Dalal's husband, Ibrahim.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Khater's condition deteriorates after his injury, Dr. Hamza tries to figure out a way to transfer him to the hospital. As Abu Shehab disappears, Sobhy decides to look for him with help from Abu Al-Nar and Abu Siyah.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sherifa learns that she is pregnant. Abu Al-Nar figures out a way to get food to the neighborhood through the large water container in the house of Umm Zaki.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Abu Ahmed and Abu Yousef arrive in the Levant, they learn that the English forces have the neighborhood besieged. With their plans to get weapons from Abu Shehab for the Palestinians at risk, they enlist the help of Umm Joseph to enter the neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Abu Jawdat recovers from his injury. Mo'taz manages to leave the neighborhood to get medication for Khater.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Abu Ahmed and Abu Yousef stay in the neighborhood to help out. Umm Ibrahim looks after Dalal when she learns of the latter's pregnancy. As the English forces demand for the neighborhood people to turn themselves in alongside the weapons, they refuse.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sherifa has a miscarriage. Khater gets transferred to the hospital and undergoes a successful operation. Mo'taz regrets threatening Abu Jawdat.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Fearing that the English forces will raid the neighborhood, the prisoners get moved to the house of Abu Hassan. The neighborhood men decide to flee before they get arrested.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Abu Dera' tells Abu Al-Nar that he killed his wife. Hamza weds Hamida. The neighborhood men prepare to leave the neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As most of the men leave the neighborhood, only a small number of them stay behind, only to get arrested and interrogated by the English forces.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The neighborhood men get tortured. Abu Jawdat interrogates Khater at the hospital. Mo'taz renews his threat to Abu Jawdat.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: In the wake of Mo'taz's threat, the neighborhood men get released. Abu Dera' talks to Al-Nems about taking the body out of the house to enable him to sell it. Abu Al-Nar asks Umm Joseph to allow Khater to live with her and look after him.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The fugitive neighborhood men get sentenced to death. The English forces take provisions from the neighborhood houses.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As Abu Yousef gets killed by the English forces, the weapons reach the Palestinians. Abu Dera' sells his house to Abu Satour.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: As Ma'amoun Bey returns to the neighborhood, he shares that he is Chief Abu Saleh's nephew. As the English forces destroy Umm Zaki's house, another location gets picked to provide the needs of the neighborhood people.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Umm Joseph kills some English officers. Abu Hatem grows suspicious of Ma'amoun Bey. Khater returns to the neighborhood. Abu Al-Nar tells Al-Nems about the plans Abu Dera' has.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Ma'amoun Bey helps the neighborhood's people. Abu Abdu gets executed by French officers. The siege of the neighborhood is broken.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Abu Hatem asks Ma'amoun Bey to find Abu Shehab. Al-Nems gets evidence that Ma'amoun is a spy. Abu Al-Nar learns that the body in the house of Abu Dera' isn't Shafiqa's. The neighborhood people get pardoned.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: As Nouri learns that Abu Jawdat has stolen the weapons, Mo'taz brings it back. Abu Jassem looks for Abu Shehab. Hoda is thrilled to discover that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Abdu becomes the manager of Abu Shehab's shop. Ma'amoun buys some properties in the neighborhood to secure it for the English forces. Fawzya is saddened when she has a miscarriage.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Fawzya takes care of an illegitimate girl called Warda. Mo'taz prepares to marry Khairiya. Sherifa learns that Abu Shehab was killed.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Mo'taz marries Khairiya. Abu Jawdat asks Abu Tahoun to kill Mo'taz and Issam. Abu Ahmed gets martyred after avenging Abu Yousef.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The English forces raid Umm Joseph's house. Ferial agrees to marry Ma'amoun Bey. It's revealed that Abu Dera' is the one who killed Abu Shehab.
